correctness.rationale: The exact face decomposition into a crown-graph join and two link cones holds for every n. Induced six-cycles in the crown graph decompose into three four-cycles using an unused label; chords reduce longer cycles, giving integral and normal generation. Cone attachments kill fundamental groups, and for n>=5 a fifth label makes the integral H2 inclusion map surjective. Exact Euler counting then yields only free top homology; the two-connected three-complex is a wedge of the stated three-spheres by Hurewicz and Whitehead. An independently implemented arc-subset directed-cycle checker matches the structural face model and mod-two ranks for n=3..10; finite results are not used in place of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: It classifies a natural strongly cyclic, minimal-nontrivial three-layer digraph blow-up in an entire infinite parameter range, explaining the exact five-column threshold by a primitive integral four-cycle bridge argument. At the excluded four-column boundary, verified mod-two H2 is nonzero, so the stabilization changes actual topology. The explicit cubic sphere count and 2-connectivity follow structurally rather than from arbitrary small-case enumeration.
